files_reviewed: grep of all non-test source for keys, localhost, VITE_ env, eval, innerHTML, CORS, localStorage
note: No .env file is committed (only .env.defaults with empty values). The Gemini key stays server-side in /api/execute and is passed only to the two chat bots. The browser token must have a read-only AccessPolicy. Patient booking has a real Confirm booking step and the server re-runs $find before $book. Cancel, complete and reschedule only touch demo-tagged appointments. Tests, docs and the tools/eval harness other than the files listed were not reviewed in depth.

labels.what: check_availability is described to the model and patient as real bookable times for a real NPPES doctor, but the Schedule it queries is invented by ensurePractitionerAndSchedule from a hash of the NPI (work days and 8-10 am start chosen by hash). No real practice calendar is consulted

deriveWeeklyTemplate makes up a weekly timetable per doctor from an NPI hash (4 day patterns, start 8/9/10, 8-hour day, 1-hour lunch). These invented hours are written to a Schedule and shown as real availability

Patient and previous-doctor pool is 983 Synthea synthetic bundles in fhir/ (generated patients, encounters, medications and practitioners with fake NPIs). The app presents these as real patients and 'Previously visited' doctors

Specialty of each seeded Synthea practitioner is guessed by majority vote over encounter reason text, using a hand-made disease to specialty table (Disease_Description.csv row order zipped with DISEASE_SPECIALTIES). Falls back to General Practice. Doctor specialties shown to patients are invented

'Appointment Confirmed' page shows a real NPPES doctor name and NPI, but the booking exists only in the demo Medplum project on an invented schedule. The doctor's office is never contacted and a daily cron deletes it (api/reset-demo.ts)

Booking prompt says never diagnose, speculate about a condition, suggest treatment or classify urgency. The model's free-text replies go straight to the patient and the reason/summary from propose_options is saved with only an empty-string check. containsInterpretationLanguage is not applied in the booking flow

check_availability schema tells the model startOffsetDays minimum 0 and windowDays 1 to 14, but the tool code uses args.startOffsetDays and args.windowDays with no clamp, so a negative offset or a very large window is passed to $find

Doctor chat prompt forbids diagnosis, interpretation, treatment advice and prognosis. The only code check is a 9-phrase substring list (containsInterpretationLanguage), which the code itself calls a weak guard. Most interpretive wording passes

When the model calls propose_options, an AI-written pre-visit summary and reason are saved as a Communication and later linked to the doctor's queue. The patient never sees or approves this text (the UI shows only the options). The booking itself does have a Confirm booking step

A model call to check_availability creates Practitioner, PractitionerRole and Schedule records for real NPPES doctors with no human approval. A provenance gate requires the NPI to come from a prior search, but nobody approves the new records

Every tool call in one model response is executed with no cap on calls per response. Each check_availability call can provision up to three new FHIR records, so one response can create records for every searched provider. Only the 8-step loop cap and the search provenance gate bound it

Server checks only that the caller holds the one shared demo ClientApplication token, then runs every action with the write-capable worker client. patientId, appointmentId and npi come from the request body with no check that the caller is that patient or doctor, so any visitor can book, cancel, reschedule or complete any demo appointment and chat as any patient

Doctor identity is just an NPI typed into the Doctor Desk (DoctorLookupPage says it is not identity verification). Anyone who enters an NPI that has an appointment with a patient gets the AI to answer from that patient's complete record. NPIs are public and shown on the confirmation page

One shared demo code gives every visitor the same role. The patient picker lists all patients and the generic /:resourceType and /Patient pages expose every record readable by the read-only token. There is no per-user login

No rate limit, per-session turn cap or message length limit on the paid Gemini actions. Each booking turn resends the whole stored transcript and retries up to 4 times, so anyone with the shared code can run up model cost
No attempt limit or lockout on demo code guesses. A correct guess returns a project access token

agent-ensure-doctor is reachable through /api/execute (ALLOWED_ACTIONS) though the UI never calls it. It writes Practitioner, PractitionerRole and Schedule records from a client-supplied npi and candidate object (name, specialty, address), skipping the provenance gate the chat path uses

Doctor chat sends the patient's whole $everything record to Gemini, including stored booking-chat transcripts typed by patients. The only defense against instructions hidden in that text is a prompt line asking the model to treat record values as data
Up to 8 MB of full patient record (PHI) is sent to a third-party model API per question. No field minimization and no check for a data processing agreement
NPPES lookup URL built by string concatenation with an unencoded npi, which can come from the client through agent-ensure-doctor
Project access token stored in sessionStorage, readable by any script on the page. index.html also loads an unused third-party Google script
Gemini retry delays add up to 81 seconds (1+4+16+60) while vercel.json caps api/execute.ts at 60 seconds, so the last retries can never finish
Model id gemini-3.5-flash-lite hardcoded here and again in geminiRequest.ts line 1 instead of config
NPPES candidate count set to three different numbers: 15 here, 10 in agent-find-doctors.ts line 45, default 20 in nppes.ts line 128
30-minute slot length hardcoded here and separately in data/core/agent-config.json line 15
Every seeded practitioner gets timezone America/New_York, and timezoneForState also defaults to New York
Dev server pinned to localhost:3000
